correctness.rationale: All independent dominating sets partition by U=I intersection original vertices. A triangle-free graph permits exactly |U|=0,1,2. Edge subdivision choices are forced for domination, and all remaining original vertices are dominated precisely under the stated support condition for |U|=1, or automatically for |U|=2. Distinct U give distinct I. The optimum bound and equality multiplicity follow from Q and neighbors of eligible vertices having degree >=2. Independent complete graph-atlas-free program enumerates all 3801 labelled connected triangle-free graphs of orders 2--6 plus three bigger examples and compares every coefficient. The proof, rather than finite data, covers all n>=3.

value.rationale: A complete natural-class classification of all maximal independent sets of central graphs, encoded by only vertex degrees, support vertices and adjacent degree sums; number of sets is exactly m+n+1-|S|, and the new optimal multiplicity is explicit. This is substantially richer than the previously published optimum size and supports enumeration in linear time from the input graph. It is structural, infinitely parameterized, and not an arbitrary numerical slice.
